documents.title: Intimation Of Record Date For Payment Of Interim Dividend For The Financial Year 2026-27.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational recovery for Q2 FY27 with revenue rising 17% year-on-year to ₹63.9 crore and PAT nearly doubling to ₹15.2 crore, driven by lower materials costs and the lifting of prior fluosilicic acid (FSA) constraints. EBITDA margin before other income expanded significantly to 36.1% as operations at Visakhapatnam returned toward normal and the final expansion phase commissioned in June 2026 contributed for the full quarter. The company announced an interim dividend of ₹2.5 per share and highlighted strategic evaluations regarding potential capacity expansion, backward integration into alumina hydrate, and adjacent fluorine derivatives. Alufluoride Limited reported its Q2 FY27 and half-year financial results, highlighting a significant recovery in revenue, margins, and profit driven by resolved raw material constraints and the capitalisation of its final expansion phase. Revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 17% year-on-year to ₹63.9 crore, while PAT nearly doubled, rising 91% to ₹15.2 crore.
